raw_context:
Combining dispensing solutions with digital health tools allows care teams to automate medication delivery while tracking metrics like continuous glucose monitoring, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, and remote patient monitoring data
. These connected systems streamline chronic disease management at home.
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
Real-time tracking:
Wearable sensors measure interstitial glucose every minute.
Automated alerts:
Warns users of high or low blood sugar trends.
Data integration:
Syncs metrics directly to remote patient monitoring platforms.
Amazon.in
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG
Vitals tracking:
Monitors heart rate, blood oxygen, and activity levels.
Cardiac monitoring:
Built-in ECG sensors detect electrical irregularities like atrial fibrillation.
Caution:
Consumer smartwatches claiming non-invasive blood glucose tracking lack clinical approval.
